records.FullPageBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} can make a new opportunity, belief, plan, or possibility feel bigger because it has somewhere to grow. Jupiter is good at seeing what could happen; keep enough perspective to notice what the opportunity will require once the excitement becomes a schedule.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} can make a new opportunity, belief, plan, or possibility feel bigger because it has somewhere to grow.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: New Moon begins a new cycle | beginnings require room for what comes next

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Full Moon across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} shows which promises, plans, or expansions have become large enough to judge by their results. Jupiter can still see the upside, but the Full Moon makes it harder to use potential as a substitute for what has actually happened.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s Full Moon across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} shows which promises, plans, or expansions have become large enough to judge by their results.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: Full Moon as culmination | axis reveals a tension already in motion

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can make a new opportunity feel like the answer before you know the scale of the commitment. Jupiter magnifies possibility; the eclipse magnifies momentum. Neither one removes the need to know what you are agreeing to carry.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can make a new opportunity feel like the answer before you know the scale of the commitment.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: Solar eclipse as a supercharged New Moon | new paths emerge while events are still unfolding

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can reveal where growth has outrun the structure meant to support it. Jupiter shows what became possible; the eclipse shows what became too large, too expensive, or too complicated to keep calling progress.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can reveal where growth has outrun the structure meant to support it.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: Lunar eclipse as culmination and revelation | what is in motion is still unfolding
